rows.sql: SELECT o.name, COUNT(p.id) AS player_count FROM owner AS o LEFT JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) LEFT JOIN player AS p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE o.name LIKE '%clay%' GROUP BY o.name

SELECT c.state_name, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_pick, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.draft_pick > 0 AND c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, t.ownership

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE (p.college <> '' AND p.mvp_awards = 0 AND p.nba_championships >= 1) AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT c.state_name, CASE WHEN p.fiba_world_cup BETWEEN 0 AND 0 THEN 'lottery' WHEN p.fiba_world_cup BETWEEN 0 AND 0 THEN 'later_first_round' WHEN p.fiba_world_cup > 0 THEN 'later_pick' ELSE 'undrafted_or_unknown' END AS draft_band, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, draft_band

SELECT p.team, p.nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.nationality <> '' GROUP BY p.team, p.nationality, t.ownership

SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(nationality) = 'American' THEN 'American' ELSE 'International' END AS nationality_group, CAST(fiba_world_cup / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS draft_decade, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality <> '' AND fiba_world_cup > 0 GROUP BY nationality_group, draft_decade

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_titles FROM team AS t JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND t.team_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team AS t JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND c.city_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY c.state_name
SELECT nationality, MAX(nba_championships) AS max_championships FROM player WHERE (nba_championships >= 1 AND nationality <> '') AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality <> '' AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY p.team

SELECT o.nationality, p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE (p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND o.nationality <> '') AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY o.nationality, p.position

SELECT t.team_name, p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY t.team_name, p.position
SELECT fiba_world_cup, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup > 0 GROUP BY fiba_world_cup

SELECT p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name IN ('California', 'Texas', 'New York', 'Florida') AND p.age BETWEEN 22 AND 34 AND p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY p.position, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) AS team_count, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN p.mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_winner_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND c.gdp >= 362000 GROUP BY c.state_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player WHERE (college <> '' AND nba_championships = 0 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt')) AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY position
SELECT fiba_world_cup, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(draft_pick) AS avg_pick, MIN(draft_pick) AS best_pick FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup > 0 AND draft_pick > 0 GROUP BY fiba_world_cup

SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_golds, SUM(olympic_gold_medals) AS total_golds, MAX(olympic_gold_medals) AS max_golds FROM player WHERE (olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND nationality <> '') AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY nationality

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(p.olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_olympic_golds, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, t.ownership
SELECT position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY position
SELECT p.team, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_draft_pick, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.draft_pick > 0 GROUP BY p.team, t.ownership

SELECT CAST(fiba_world_cup / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS draft_decade, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND draft_pick BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND fiba_world_cup > 0 GROUP BY draft_decade
SELECT t.founded_year, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY t.founded_year
SELECT t.ownership, AVG(p.age) AS avg_player_age FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.ownership

SELECT c.city_name, SUM(p.mvp_awards) AS total_mvp, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.mvp_awards >= 1 GROUP BY c.city_name, t.ownership

SELECT p.position, COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) AS titled_team_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND t.championship >= 1 GROUP BY p.position, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND o.nba_team LIKE '%brooklyn%' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT o.nationality, c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE (o.nationality <> '' AND c.state_name <> '') AND c.gdp >= 362000 GROUP BY o.nationality, c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.age) AS avg_age, MAX(p.mvp_awards) AS max_mvp, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, t.ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT position, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(mvp_awards) AS avg_mvp, AVG(nba_championships) AS avg_titles FROM player WHERE (position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND NOT mvp_awards IS NULL AND NOT nba_championships IS NULL) AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY position

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS team_count, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_titles, MAX(t.championship) AS max_titles, MIN(t.founded_year) AS earliest_founded FROM team AS t JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND c.city_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT p.position, AVG(p.mvp_awards) AS avg_mvp, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.mvp_awards >= 1 AND t.founded_year < 1980 AND p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY p.position, t.ownership

SELECT o.nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE p.olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND o.own_year >= 1990 AND o.nationality <> '' GROUP BY o.nationality, t.ownership

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE o.own_year >= 2000 AND p.draft_year >= 2000 AND p.draft_pick > 0 AND p.draft_pick <= 30 GROUP BY t.team_name, t.ownership
SELECT fiba_world_cup, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup BETWEEN 0 AND 0 GROUP BY fiba_world_cup

SELECT position, CASE WHEN age < 30 THEN 'under_30' WHEN age < 40 THEN '30s' ELSE '40_or_older' END AS age_band, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE (position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND NOT age IS NULL) AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY position, age_band
SELECT location, AVG(championship) AS avg_championships FROM team WHERE (championship >= 1 AND location <> '') AND ownership LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY location
SELECT p.team, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE t.championship >= 3 AND p.age < 30 GROUP BY p.team, t.ownership
SELECT position, AVG(olympic_gold_medals) AS avg_olympic_golds FROM player WHERE (olympic_gold_medals >= 1 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt')) AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY position
SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(p.id) AS player_count FROM team AS t LEFT JOIN player AS p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE t.team_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY t.team_name

SELECT CAST(olympic_gold_medals / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS draft_decade, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(draft_pick) AS avg_pick, MIN(draft_pick) AS best_pick, MAX(draft_pick) AS latest_pick FROM player WHERE olympic_gold_medals > 0 AND draft_pick > 0 GROUP BY draft_decade HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
SELECT nationality, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM owner WHERE nba_team LIKE '%brooklyn%' GROUP BY nationality

SELECT o.name, MAX(p.nba_championships) AS max_player_titles, o.nba_team FROM owner AS o LEFT JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) LEFT JOIN player AS p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY o.name, o.nba_team
SELECT p.team, SUM(p.fiba_world_cup) AS total_fiba_titles FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON p.team = t.team_name WHERE p.fiba_world_cup >= 1 AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY p.team
SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE team <> '' AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY team

SELECT CAST(fiba_world_cup / 5 AS INTEGER) * 5 AS draft_cohort, position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE fiba_world_cup > 0 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY draft_cohort, position

SELECT position, CASE WHEN mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 'mvp_winner' ELSE 'no_mvp' END AS mvp_status, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY position, mvp_status
SELECT state_name, MAX(gdp) AS max_gdp FROM city WHERE (population > 1000000 AND state_name <> '') AND gdp >= 362000 GROUP BY state_name

SELECT p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE t.championship = 0 AND p.draft_year > 2000 AND p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY p.position, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, p.position, t.ownership
SELECT state_name, AVG(population) AS avg_population FROM city WHERE state_name <> '' AND city_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY state_name
SELECT t.championship, AVG(p.mvp_awards) AS avg_mvp, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.championship, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY c.state_name
SELECT position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE (age >= 30 AND nba_championships >= 1 AND position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt')) AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY position

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE (c.population > 1000000 AND p.nba_championships >= 1 AND c.state_name <> '') AND c.gdp >= 362000 GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT t.ownership, p.position, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND t.ownership <> '' GROUP BY t.ownership, p.position

SELECT p.position, c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.draft_pick) AS avg_pick, MIN(p.draft_year) AS earliest_draft, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE p.position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND p.draft_pick > 0 AND c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY p.position, c.state_name, t.ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT position, CASE WHEN nba_championships >= 1 THEN 'has_championship' WHEN nba_championships = 0 THEN 'no_championship' ELSE 'unknown' END AS championship_status, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY position, championship_status
SELECT location, MAX(championship) AS max_championships FROM team WHERE location <> '' AND team_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY location

SELECT position, CASE WHEN fiba_world_cup BETWEEN 0 AND 0 THEN 'lottery' WHEN fiba_world_cup BETWEEN 0 AND 0 THEN 'later_first_round' WHEN fiba_world_cup > 0 THEN 'later_pick' ELSE 'undrafted_or_unknown' END AS draft_band, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') GROUP BY position, draft_band

SELECT CAST(o.own_year / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS acquisition_decade, COUNT(*) AS owner_count, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_team_titles, MIN(o.own_year) AS earliest_acquisition, MAX(o.own_year) AS latest_acquisition FROM owner AS o JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE o.own_year > 0 AND o.nba_team LIKE '%brooklyn%' GROUP BY acquisition_decade

SELECT t.ownership, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_player_titles, SUM(CASE WHEN p.fiba_world_cup >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fiba_winner_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE t.ownership <> '' AND NOT p.nba_championships IS NULL AND NOT p.fiba_world_cup IS NULL GROUP BY t.ownership HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.fiba_world_cup >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
SELECT position, AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY position

SELECT CAST(founded_year / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS founded_decade, CASE WHEN championship >= 1 THEN 'has_title' ELSE 'no_title' END AS title_status, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team WHERE founded_year > 0 AND team_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY founded_decade, title_status
SELECT position, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MAX(age) AS max_age FROM player WHERE position IN ('Frontcourt', 'Backcourt') AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY position
SELECT CAST(own_year / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS acquisition_decade, COUNT(*) AS owner_count FROM owner WHERE own_year >= 2000 AND name LIKE '%clay%' GROUP BY acquisition_decade
SELECT college, COUNT(*) AS champion_count FROM player WHERE (nba_championships >= 1 AND college <> '') AND name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY college

SELECT state_name, COUNT(*) AS city_count, AVG(population) AS avg_population, MAX(population) AS max_population, SUM(gdp) AS total_area FROM city WHERE state_name <> '' AND NOT population IS NULL AND NOT gdp IS NULL GROUP BY state_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, AVG(p.age) AS avg_age, SUM(CASE WHEN p.mvp_awards >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mvp_winner_count, MAX(t.championship) AS team_titles, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY t.team_name, t.ownership HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

SELECT o.name, COUNT(p.id) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM owner AS o LEFT JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) LEFT JOIN player AS p ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) GROUP BY o.name, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, MIN(p.draft_pick) AS earliest_pick FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE (p.draft_pick > 0 AND c.state_name <> '') AND c.gdp >= 362000 GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT t.team_name, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN owner AS o ON TRIM(t.team_name) = TRIM(o.nba_team) WHERE p.college <> '' AND p.mvp_awards = 0 AND p.nba_championships >= 1 GROUP BY t.team_name, t.ownership

SELECT c.state_name, CASE WHEN p.draft_pick BETWEEN 1 AND 14 THEN 'lottery' WHEN p.draft_pick BETWEEN 15 AND 30 THEN 'later_first_round' WHEN p.draft_pick > 30 THEN 'later_pick' ELSE 'undrafted_or_unknown' END AS draft_band, COUNT(*) AS player_count, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' GROUP BY c.state_name, draft_band, t.ownership

SELECT p.team, p.nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON TRIM(p.team) = TRIM(t.team_name) WHERE p.nationality <> '' AND p.name LIKE '%aaron%' GROUP BY p.team, p.nationality

SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(nationality) = 'American' THEN 'American' ELSE 'International' END AS nationality_group, CAST(olympic_gold_medals / 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 AS draft_decade, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality <> '' AND olympic_gold_medals > 0 GROUP BY nationality_group, draft_decade

SELECT c.state_name, AVG(t.championship) AS avg_titles FROM team AS t JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND c.city_name LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY c.state_name

SELECT c.state_name, COUNT(*) AS team_count FROM team AS t JOIN city AS c ON c.city_name = CASE t.location WHEN 'Brooklyn' THEN 'New York City' WHEN 'Washington' THEN 'Washington, D.C.' ELSE t.location END WHERE c.state_name <> '' AND t.ownership LIKE '%atlanta%' GROUP BY c.state_name
SELECT nationality, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM player WHERE nationality <> '' AND birth_date LIKE '%1919/3/23%' GROUP BY nationality
SELECT p.team, AVG(p.nba_championships) AS avg_championships, t.ownership FROM player AS p JOIN team AS t ON p.team = t.team_name GROUP BY p.team, t.ownership
